records.issue_text: 2009/2012 vendor prefix stack in all four mixins is dead code with no supported-browser floor or verification, incurring maintenance cost without acceptance criteria
records.rationale: The diff adds four new flexbox-related mixins in `app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss` (`flexbox`, `inline-flex`, `align-items`, `order`) that include multiple legacy 2009/2012-era vendor-prefixed properties (e.g., `display: -webkit-box;`, `display: -moz-box;`, `-webkit-box-align`, `-moz-box-ordinal-group`, `-ms-flexbox`). The finding’s concern about unverified/unsupported legacy prefix stacks adding ongoing maintenance cost is a specific review concern grounded in these newly introduced lines, even though it’s not a directly verifiable functional bug from the diff alone.

records.issue_text: -moz-inline-box at mixins.scss:110 is not a valid value
records.rationale: The diff adds `display: -moz-inline-box;` in `@mixin inline-flex()` (mixins.scss). If that value is not recognized by target browsers, the declaration will be ignored. However, the mixin immediately follows it with other `display` declarations (`-ms-inline-flexbox`, `inline-flex`, etc.), so even if `-moz-inline-box` is invalid/useless, it likely won’t break behavior; it’s a specific compatibility/cleanliness concern rather than a clear functional defect from this diff alone.
